title: AgentCognitionER instance v1
description: An instance of the governed-cognition entity/relation model (ER-1, companion to ADR-0002). The reference ER's literal tokens (AGENT, DECISION_CYCLE, OBSERVATION, GRAPH_ENTITY/EDGE, FAIR_OBJECT/METADATA, PROVENANCE_RECORD, VECTOR_CHUNK, ACTION, POLICY_CHECK, AUDIT_EVENT, BELIEF_STATE, PLAN, EVIDENCE_BUNDLE, DATASET_VERSION, MODEL_VERSION) originate in prophet-platform/apps/socioprophet-web/public/workbench/unified_cognitive_systems_map.html; this schema makes them a validatable contract. The cross-field TEETH (every ACTION gated_by POLICY_CHECK + recorded_as AUDIT_EVENT; every PROVENANCE_RECORD depends_on DATASET_VERSION + includes MODEL_VERSION; every memory item carries topic_set+span+domain) are enforced by validate_agent_cognition_er.py, not by JSON Schema alone. The enum lists here are drift-guarded against the Python model (agent_cognition_er.py) by validate_schema().

entities.description: Entity records, keyed by ER entity type.
